cases.title: Lesson topics
cases.task: Use the keyboard to read the Practice topic.

expectedDefects.reason: The Practice tab is outside sequential focus and no arrow handler provides access to its hidden panel.

cases.title: Lesson topics
cases.task: Use the keyboard to read the Practice topic.
cases.control: Arrow keys focus and activate the next tab. Scope the clean judgment to this keyboard task; click behavior is outside the task.

cases.title: Lesson topics
cases.task: Use the keyboard to read the Practice topic.
cases.control: Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space activates the panel. Focus movement without immediate selection is intentional.

cases.title: Choose a topic
cases.task: Choose Practice with the topic selector.
cases.control: A missing native-popup trace is an evidence limit, not proof that the selector is broken.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Show the hint and determine whether the control reports its expanded state.

expectedDefects.reason: The panel opens but aria-expanded remains false.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Show the hint and determine whether the control reports its expanded state.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Use the keyboard to open and close the explanation.

expectedDefects.reason: The custom disclosure responds to clicks but neither Enter nor Space.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Use the keyboard to open and close the explanation.
cases.control: Enter and Space work; aria-controls is optional.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Toggle inclusion of practice questions and determine the checked state.

expectedDefects.reason: Visible inclusion changes but the checkbox remains announced as unchecked.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Toggle inclusion of practice questions and determine the checked state.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Use Space to toggle inclusion of practice questions.

expectedDefects.reason: The custom checkbox only responds to a pointer, so Space cannot change the choice.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Use Space to toggle inclusion of practice questions.
cases.control: Space toggles the choice; Enter is not required.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: In the open reminder editor, use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through its controls.

expectedDefects.reason: The dialog claims to be modal but permits keyboard focus to reach background controls.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: In the open reminder editor, use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through its controls.
cases.control: The modal dialog explicitly wraps sequential focus between its first and last controls.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Dismiss the open reminder editor using Escape.

expectedDefects.reason: The dialog cancels native Escape dismissal, leaving the editor open.

cases.title: Lesson activity
cases.task: Dismiss the open reminder editor using Escape.
cases.control: Escape closes the native modal dialog.
